archfey-patron.summary: A warlock bound to a fey power, blinking around the battlefield with free Misty Steps that carry extra tricks.

Archfey Spells.summary: Always-prepared patron spells at Warlock levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (fey charms, teleports and illusions); they don't count against your prepared spells.

Steps of the Fey.summary: Cast Misty Step with no slot CHA times (min 1) per Long Rest. Each casting of it can add one step effect: temp HP to you or an ally, or a WIS save that makes nearby foes worse at attacking anyone but you.

options.name: Refreshing Step
options.summary: Right after the teleport, you or a creature you see within 10 ft gets 1d10 temp HP.

options.name: Taunting Step
options.summary: Foes within 5 ft of where you left make a WIS save or attack others than you at Disadvantage until your next turn starts.
options.duration: until the start of your next turn

Misty Escape.summary: Misty Step becomes a Reaction you can take when you're damaged. Two more step effects join Steps of the Fey: brief invisibility, or a psychic burst.

options.name: Disappearing Step
options.summary: You turn Invisible until your next turn starts, ending early once you attack, deal damage or cast.
options.duration: until the start of your next turn

options.name: Dreadful Step
options.summary: Creatures within 5 ft of your start or end point (pick one) make a WIS save or take 2d10 psychic.

Beguiling Defenses.summary: Immune to Charmed. Reaction when a seen attacker hits you: halve the damage, and on a failed WIS save it takes psychic damage equal to what you took. 1/Long Rest, or spend a Pact slot to reuse.

Bewitching Magic.summary: After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a slot, you also get a free Misty Step within that same action, no slot needed.

celestial-patron.summary: A warlock serving a heavenly power, mixing pact magic with healing and radiant fire.

Celestial Spells.summary: Always-prepared patron spells at Warlock levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (healing, light and radiant magic); they don't count against your prepared spells.

Healing Light.summary: A pool of d6s equal to 1 + Warlock level, refilled on a Long Rest. Bonus Action: spend up to CHA dice (min 1) to heal yourself or a creature you see within 60 ft by their total.

Radiant Soul.summary: Resistance to Radiant. Once per turn, a spell of yours dealing Radiant or Fire damage adds your CHA to the damage against one target.

Celestial Resilience.summary: Each rest (Short or Long) and each Magical Cunning gives you temp HP of Warlock level + CHA; up to five creatures you see get half your level + CHA.

Searing Vengeance.summary: When you or an ally within 60 ft is about to roll a death save, they instead heal half their max HP and may stand up; foes you pick within 30 ft of them take 2d8 + CHA radiant and are Blinded this turn. 1/Long Rest.
Searing Vengeance.duration: until the end of the current turn

Hurl Through Hell.duration: until the end of your next turn

great-old-one-patron.summary: A warlock touched by an alien elder being, wielding telepathy, psychic damage and mind-warping curses.

Awakened Mind.summary: Bonus Action: open a two-way telepathic link with a creature you see within 30 ft. Works up to CHA miles apart (min 1) for minutes equal to your Warlock level; a shared language is needed. A new link ends the old one.

Great Old One Spells.summary: Always-prepared patron spells at Warlock levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (mind-reading, madness and aberrant magic); they don't count against your prepared spells.

Psychic Spells.summary: Your damaging Warlock spells may deal Psychic instead of their normal type, and your Warlock Enchantment and Illusion spells need no Verbal or Somatic components.

Clairvoyant Combatant.summary: When you make an Awakened Mind link, the target can be forced to make a WIS save; if it fails, while the link lasts it attacks you at Disadvantage and you attack it with Advantage. 1/Short or Long Rest, or spend a Pact slot to reuse.

Eldritch Hex.summary: Hex is always prepared for you. Its target also has Disadvantage on saves of the ability you picked for the curse.

Thought Shield.summary: No one can read your mind unless you let them. Resistance to Psychic, and anyone who deals you psychic damage takes the same amount you took.

Create Thrall.summary: Summon Aberration can skip Concentration (lasting 1 minute); the summon then starts with temp HP of Warlock level + CHA. Once per turn its hit on a hexed creature adds Hex's extra psychic damage.
